context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Equipment installed six months ago has a failed compressor. Cause/responsibility remains inconclusive: product defect and utility disturbance both possible. Manager explicitly authorised customer-care repair and Frostline exposure before final responsibility to restore critical service. Engineer is competent and replacement is tested as permanent remedial outcome; report/conditions retained.

Gross attributable remedial cost: labour/travel £700, purchased compressor £900, refrigerant £200, freight/access £200 = £2,000 excluding VAT. Manufacturer claim M-18 offers parts-only £900 credit pending return/test; no labour, refrigerant, freight or access acceptance. No credit processed or customer charge agreed.

Failed compressor labelled with customer/site/asset/job/claim sits in warehouse evidence hold. RMA return/test deadline five days; insurer has requested preservation because same failure caused separately investigated damage. Engineer proposes scrapping it now that service works. Customer is told support is initially no charge pending investigation, not admitted liability.

unknowns: Coordinated RMA and insurer evidence release
Actual recovery and ultimate commercial treatment
request: Process the remedial report and manufacturer offer; the customer wants assurance it was all a free warranty repair.
